item.text:
**4B.7 Research Note**

Verdict: I found no credible 2024 evidence that Khamenei protected political equality for minorities, women, excluded groups, opposition regions, or unpopular viewpoints. The year’s strongest evidence is negative. The only positive material I found was narrow and procedural: a temporary pause of the stricter hijab law and the survival of one low-key moderate in the presidential contest, neither of which shows durable equality.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iran: Chokehold on Dissent | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent | HRW said authorities killed and detained protesters, targeted critics, and continued repressing ethnic and religious minorities. It specifically notes discrimination and pressure against Baha’is, Sunnis, and non-Persian minorities, which cuts directly against political equality. | 4B.7, 4B.3, 4B.5, 3B.10 |
| Iran: authorities unleash heavily militarized clampdown to hide protest massacres | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/ | Amnesty documented surveillance, police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, and prison terms used against women defying hijab rules. This is direct evidence of unequal treatment and coercive enforcement against women, not protection of equality. | 4B.7, 4B.3, 4B.5 |
| Iran: Women and Girls Facing Violent Crackdown | Amnesty International | 2024-05-07 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde13/8029/2024/en/ | Amnesty said security forces intensified compulsory-veiling enforcement through surveillance, beatings, sexual violence, electric shocks, arbitrary arrest, and detention. This is strong evidence against equal treatment of women and girls. | 4B.7, 4B.3, 4B.5, 3B.10 |
| Iran: New President Should Confront Rights Abuses | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-12 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/12/iran-new-president-should-confront-rights-abuses | HRW noted massive boycott, the lowest first-round turnout in Iran’s presidential election history, and continued repression of women, minorities, and civil society. This is evidence that excluded groups still lacked equal political standing. | 4B.7, 4B.1, 4B.3, 4B.5 |
| Khamenei protege, sole moderate neck and neck in Iran presidential race | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-27 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514 | A low-key moderate and a Khamenei protege were neck-and-neck in the snap presidential vote. This is the closest thing I found to a positive signal, but it reflects tightly bounded competition, not equal protection for excluded viewpoints or groups. | 4B.7, 4B.1, 4B.2 |
| Iran pauses implementation of stricter hijab law for women | Euronews / AP | 2024-12-18 | https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women | Senior bodies temporarily paused implementation of the stricter hijab law after backlash. This is the clearest limited positive signal, but it was temporary and procedural, not a durable move toward equality. | 4B.7, 4B.2, 4B.3, 4B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find any reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei actively protected equality for Baha’is, Sunnis, Kurds, Baluch, women, or opposition regions.
- The positive signals I found were narrow and defensive, not affirmative equality measures.
